description: Clean-room SandTie H3 kinetic choreography vocabulary built with clear skeletal shoulder, spine, hip, arm, and footwork phrasing.

pacing_rules.motion_language: Describe smooth natural speed transitions ('glides gently', 'snaps crisply', 'rolls steadily') rather than numeric Hz values.
pacing_rules.anatomy_order: Describe clear skeletal motion across feet, knees, hips, shoulders, elbows, wrists, and hair inertia—keep movement rooted in posture shifts, footwork, and arm lines rather than chest-bouncing jargon.
pacing_rules.orientation_lock: State initial body angle toward or away from camera in [Shot 1], keeping left/right hand placement concrete in every beat.
pacing_rules.fingertip_rule: Articulate choreography down to wrists, palms, knuckles, and individual fingers (sequential pinky-to-thumb curls, 90-degree wrist hinges, interlocked finger-tutting frames, sharp finger-gun recoils, and fingertips grazing lens or jawline), pairing hand snaps with motivated gimbal drops, whip pans, or crane reveals.

core_actions: figure-eight hip sway shifting weight smoothly left to right
vertical spine wave rolling seamlessly from shoulders through waist and hips
sharp shoulder-and-torso snap followed by controlled posture release
slow 360-degree pivot turn planting heels cleanly on the final beat
controlled deep knee drop rising smoothly through the lower spine
upper_body_and_hands: fingertips gliding lightly along collarbone toward the jawline
both palms sweeping slowly behind hair and resting briefly at the nape
index finger tracing an unhurried beckon toward the lens
hands bracing lightly on waist/hips framing hip rotations
finales_and_poses: settles weight cleanly onto one hip with poised chin tilt and unbroken eye lock
turns three-quarters back over one shoulder holding a knowing smirk
steps smoothly toward the lens landing in an intimate upper-body hold
tiktok_and_kpop_flows: crisp double shoulder-and-torso snap flowing smoothly into a liquid vertical spine wave
rapid figure-eight hip shake on bent knees with clean weight shift and flowing hair inertia
playful cheek-poke finger heart and glossy idol wink held cleanly at beat end
smooth knee drop sweeping palms up outer thighs while tossing hair backward
elbow-locked isolated upper-torso slides snapping left to right on percussive hits
club_twerk_and_heels: deep lumbar spine arch pulsing isolated rhythmic hip-and-glute bounces with rhythmic knee drive
weightless 360-degree chrome pole orbit spin melting into a slow thigh-hook descent
confident stiletto catwalk cross-step snapping into a 180-degree hair-whip lookback
sultry chair reverse-straddle back arch rolling steadily from collarbone through waist
douyin_and_trending_flows: rapid crossed wrist-rolls paired with crisp inward-outward ankle glide steps (Subject Three / Kemusan)
alternating bent-wrist cat-paw sway with bouncy hip taps and cheerful head tilts
snappy wrist-flick silk folding fan opening beside a fluid 360-degree flowing-sleeve spin
breezy side-step groove with shoulder shrug, hair tuck behind the ear, and finger-heart wink
weightless floating slickback foot-swap glide beneath calm swinging arms
kpop_fingertip_tutting_and_mv_cuts: sequential pinky-to-index finger-wave ripple gliding across collarbone level with elbows locked taut
90-degree geometric wrist hinges forming clean right-angle L-boxes and interlocked finger triangles framing one eye
pinky-to-thumb blossom curl snapping open diagonal arms cleanly into chest-height fists
open fingertips reaching straight toward wide-angle glass triggering a crisp beat-synced gimbal downward drop and micro-shake
anti-drop dead-stop freeze on poised fingertip command pose exploding immediately into crisp heel-toe crisscross footwork
